detaileddescription.para: ThemisDB | File: access_coordinator.h | Version: 2.0.0 Maturity: 🟡 ALPHA (Phase 2 Implementation) | Status: Active development Author: Copilot | Date: 2026-08-03

The AccessCoordinator is the central broker that manages tier transitions between cache and storage tiers. It receives eviction events from cache, access patterns from storage, and applies unified aging policies to make promotion/demotion decisions.

listitem.para: EvictionListener / PromotionListener are thin interfaces used by cache and storage modules to emit raw events.
AccessCoordinator is the full coordinator that receives structured events (EvictionEvent, AccessEvent) and drives tier transitions.
